title: ZNC SMP
description: An evolving survival SMP with dynamic market pricing, teams, land claims, and player trading. Fully non-P2W — power is earned through grinding, smart economics, PvP, alliances, and betrayal.
body:
# ZNC SMP

ZNC SMP is an evolving survival multiplayer server built around one core principle: **no pay-to-win, ever.** This server was created so my son — and players like him — can experience a fair, competitive SMP where progress is earned through gameplay, not purchases.

We are actively developing new systems and refining mechanics to create a long-term, player-driven world.

---

## Core Features

### 💰 Player-Driven Economy

* Dynamic market pricing that reacts to supply and demand
* Player trading system
* Grind, invest, or dominate the market

### 🏰 Teams & Land Claiming

* Form alliances or build your own faction
* Secure land claims to protect your base
* Strategic expansion and territorial control

### ⚔ Risk & Reward Gameplay

* PvP-enabled survival
* Earn power through grinding, smart economics, alliances — or betrayal
* No paid advantages, no purchasable power

---

## Philosophy

ZNC SMP is designed to reward:

* Strategy
* Effort
* Smart decision-making
* Social dynamics

Everything in the server can be acquired through gameplay. There are no paid ranks, no purchasable gear advantages, and no shortcuts to power.. unlessed teamed with strong progressed players.

---

## Development Status

This is a growing project. New systems, balance adjustments, and features are being added over time. Player feedback directly influences development.

If you’re looking for a fair survival experience where dominance is earned — not bought — ZNC SMP is built for you.
